data.body: RP-06 `review-plan --retry` budget decision approved by maintainer: retry is an explicit override and each invocation authorizes a fresh attempt budget. The effective ceiling is resolved for and enforced independently on that retry attempt; it is not cumulative across the lineage. Previously budget-shed calls remain missing and are eligible in the retry. If the fresh budget still cannot cover all missing work, the new attempt may remain INDETERMINATE and another explicit retry may authorize another budget. Persist per-attempt and cumulative lineage spend for auditability, but cumulative spend is telemetry only and never blocks. Successful content-identical calls remain reused, so fresh budget does not imply replaying successful work. RP-01 same-operation recovery remains bounded and never mints a fresh attempt budget. Local note updated: `.joe-janitor/rp06-review-plan-retry-research.md`.
